retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated sepia-toned composition featuring a large foreground portrait offset to the right against a deep-perspective industrial street scene with centered serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif styles are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated sepia image where a male subject in a dark jacket occupies the right foreground, looking away from the camera. The background features a vanishing point perspective of an industrial street with brick buildings, utility poles, and a vintage car, all set against a blown-out white sky that provides a canvas for elegant serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject scale vs. distant background elements
Verticality of utility poles and buildings vs. horizontal road lines
Dark tonal values of the subject vs. the high-key white sky
coreInvariants: Monochromatic sepia or warm-grey color grade
Deep linear perspective leading to a vanishing point
Negative space in the upper third for typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is a medium-close-up portrait positioned in the right third, cropped at the waist and shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark silhouette against the light background acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large typography at the top, move down to the subject on the right, then follow the road lines into the background perspective on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the upper sky area and the open road on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm grey and sepia mid-tones for the environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the subject's clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold or olive-tinted grey for the primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Very low saturation; high value contrast between the dark foreground and the overexposed sky.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal tracking for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' has a long, elegant descender hook

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a large, tracked-out serif display name with a much smaller, extremely wide-tracked sans-serif or simple serif subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with elegant proportions.
Extreme stroke contrast for a more fashion-forward look.
Classical Roman proportions suitable for cinematic titles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned industrial street scene with a vanishing point on the left. Place a man in a dark blazer in the right foreground, looking away. Ensure the top 30% of the image is a clear, overexposed white sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, centered, wide-tracked serif font in a muted olive-grey color. Add a subtitle below it in a significantly smaller size with extreme letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the sky bright enough to make text legible?
Is the perspective leading the eye into the distance?
Is the color palette strictly desaturated sepia?
Is the typography centered and uppercase?

mustRedesign: Avoid using any modern digital filters that look artificial
Ensure the subject does not overlap the text
Maintain the high-key sky to prevent text legibility issues
postGenerationChecks: Check for clear separation between foreground and background
Verify the vanishing point is off-center
Ensure the sepia tone is consistent across the image
Confirm the text is perfectly centered horizontally
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Background + Asymmetric Foreground Portrait + Sepia Grade + High-Key Sky + Tracked-out Serif Typography
